content:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] High preemption rate observed in inference pool us-west-2-g4. Severity: P1. Impacting ~12% of requests with elevated latency and ~6% failed token streams. Auto-eviction started at 02:13 UTC. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1793456789
jamie: paging oncall — I got it, joining bridge. seeing <50ms spikes then long tails.
sasha: I'm on the bridge too. quick symptom summary from logs: repeated CUDA OOM triggers during batch assembly, then kube evict loops.
mike: any customer-facing degradations? Support says some realtime customers reported truncated responses and reconnect loops.
support-bot: customer-tickets: #INC-9871 (chat drops), #INC-9874 (slow completion). Tier 1 flagged a few enterprise customers for SRE follow-up.
aria: assigning temporary mitigation: set pool autoscaler to conservative mode (scaleDownDelay=10m) and reduce maxBatchSize from 64 -> 32. Will roll in 30s.
jamie: applying autoscaler tweak now.

ops-bot: command executed: 
```
rbx autoscaler update us-west-2-g4 --max-batch=32 --scale-down-delay=600
```
ops-bot: change applied across 3 node pools. Monitoring metrics now.
sasha: trending: dropped preemptions from 18% -> 7% within 90s. Latency 95th improved but some backlog remains.
mike: can we light-weight route heavy customers to dedicated pool to buy time? Any spare capacity in dedicated fleet?
aria: we have two reserved nodes in dedicated-west but not certified for these models. Could fallback to a smaller model variant for a subset of traffic.
jamie: initiating partial routing by tag `low_latency` -> model-variant:v2-smaller. Patching routing rule.

ops-bot: routing update:
```
rbx route add-rule --from=low_latency --to=model-variant:v2-smaller --weight=0.25 --region=us-west-2
```
ops-bot: rule created. Traffic shift started.

mike: telemetry shows small increase in quality regression alerts; product: are we ok with 25% shifted to smaller model for 1 hour?
aria: Product approved for immediate mitigation. We will monitor eval metric `bleu-ish` and rollback if delta > 3%.

jamie: scheduling a postmortem and action list. Proposed PM: @sasha; SRE owner: @jamie; infra owner: @aria. Proposed postmortem slot: today 18:00 UTC.
sasha: ack, I'll draft the timeline and initial RCA bullets.

jamie: initial suspected root cause: kernel scheduling interaction under high bursty batch assembly leading to uneven memory pressure, aggravated by recent kubelet node-image churn. Need to validate with traces.
mike: action items (quick list):
- INF-4321: increase eviction thresholds on us-west-2 node class (owner: aria, ETA: 24h)
- INF-4322: autoscaler policy hardening + test harness for burst patterns (owner: jamie, ETA: 48h)
- INF-4323: model-variant cold-start perf test and certify for dedicated pools (owner: mike, ETA: 72h)
- DOC-214: update playbook for partial routing and product sign-off flow (owner: sasha, ETA: 1 week)

aria: created JIRA tickets: INF-4321, INF-4322, INF-4323. Linking incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321

support-bot: Notifying affected customers: sent templated note to enterprise contacts for INC-9871 and INC-9874. CS lead: @maya.

maya: will run customer outreach and ensure followups. ETA for customer update: 2 hours.

sasha: postmortem invite sent to `#postmortems` and calendar. Meeting link attached. I'll include metric snapshots and the `dmesg` + kube-event timeline in the doc.

jamie: closing bridge — mitigation stable. keeping incident open for postmortem and action tracking.

oncall-bot: Incident status changed to stable at 02:45 UTC. Postmortem scheduled for 18:00 UTC. Incident channel: #inc-1793456789

aria: quick follow-up: we noticed a failing node-image GC job that coincided with a spike in image pulls, increasing kube pressure. Adding cleanup schedule to nodepool config as short-term.

mike: note for infra: investigate interaction between image GC and our eviction heuristics — potential design fix rather than temp knob.

sasha: I'll own the RCA doc. Plan to include replay steps, timeline, and the three JIRAs above. Anyone else want to add items?

maya: I'll include customer impact summary and a list of customers who want a 1:1.

jamie: thanks all. final action: we'll validate that the autoscaler change didn't cause oscillation during next few hours; if any sign, revert to previous settings and escalate.

sasha: last note — recording attached from the bridge and core dump tarball uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/1793456789/core-dumps.tar.gz :eyes:

support-bot: incident closed for paging at 02:47 UTC. Follow-ups tracked in INF-4321/4322/4323 and DOC-214. :white_check_mark:
